title: Reading lab: Mark 4:35–41
subtitle: Follow scene, command, action, and rhetorical question.
overview: This scene joins narrative verbs, direct commands, a participial setting, and Jesus’ questions. Map each speaker and event before interpreting the storm image.
Notice how the disciples’ fear and Jesus’ question create the scene’s final rhetorical tension.

items.grc: καὶ λέγει αὐτοῖς· τί δειλοί ἐστε; οὔπω ἔχετε πίστιν;
items.en: And he says to them, “Why are you afraid? Do you not yet have faith?”

items.grc: καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν φόβον μέγαν καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς ἀλλήλους· τίς ἄρα οὗτός ἐστιν;
items.en: And they feared a great fear and said to one another, “Who then is this?”
